narrative.intro: Battelle Energy Alliance has $2.1B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Battelle Energy Alliance won 1 award so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $2.1B. Obligations are up 10.1% year over year. Historical obligations show FY21 at $1.3B, FY22 at $1.6B, FY23 at $2.2B, FY24 at $1.9B, and FY25 at $1.9B. The FY26 total of $2.1B continues the multi-year trend where obligations peaked at $2.2B in FY23 and remained near $1.9B in FY24 and FY25. These figures are contract obligations; award-value figures in some tables are total contract values and current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date. This snapshot is useful for contractors and procurement analysts tracking large, single-award activity and year-over-year movement in obligations for Battelle Energy Alliance.
